strongest_verified_claim: For every n>=1, the maximal finite CP-plus-rank equals maximal ordinary CP-rank p_n; equality also holds with attained maxima on every exact ordinary-rank stratum1<=r<=n. Singular matrices are included.
mechanism: Small negative rank-one congruence keeps a chosen positive factor strictly positive while its strictly positive inverse pulls back any shortest nonnegative factor. Positive smoothing plus closed ordinary-rank sublevels attains the converse extrema. No positive-definiteness or closedness of exact-rank strata is assumed.
remaining_mathematical_gap: General maximal finite pointwise cp-plus/cp gap (separate Question1), and explicit numerical p_n for alln, are not determined. They are not prerequisites to Question2 equality.
